river_and_tanks.foothills_river: Swarnamukhi River (Flows through Tirupati valley at the foot of Seshachalam Hills)
river_and_tanks.main_temple_tank: Swami Pushkarini (Sacred water tank adjacent to Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple, Tirumala)

theerthams.name: Swami Pushkarini
theerthams.description: Sacred temple tank brought from Vaikuntha by Garuda. Taking a holy dip here before entering the temple is considered spiritually cleansing.

theerthams.name: Papavinasanam Theertham
theerthams.location: 5 km North of Tirumala Main Temple
theerthams.description: Perennial waterfall and reservoir equipped with structured shower spouts for pilgrims to bathe safely.

theerthams.name: Akasa Ganga Theertham
theerthams.location: 3 km North of Tirumala Main Temple
theerthams.description: Natural mountain stream whose holy water is collected daily for Sri Venkateswara Swamy Abhishekam.

theerthams.name: Kapila Theertham
theerthams.location: KT Road, Foot of Tirumala Hills, Tirupati
theerthams.description: Sacred waterfall flowing down Seshachalam rocks into a large pond at the ancient Kapileswara Swamy Temple.

theerthams.name: Chakra Theertham
theerthams.description: Holy water spot where Lord Vishnu's Sudarshana Chakra is believed to have struck the rocks to create a stream.

theerthams.name: Gogarbham & Pandava Theertham
theerthams.location: Near Gogarbham Dam, Tirumala Forest Zone
theerthams.description: Gogarbham Dam serves as a key water source for Tirumala; Pandava Theertham is a nearby sacred natural stream site.

safety_and_cleanliness_guidelines: Use designated steps, non-slip mats, and stainless steel railings while entering Swami Pushkarini.
Soaps, shampoos, detergents, washing clothes, and swimming are strictly prohibited in all holy tanks and streams.
Swami Pushkarini features 24/7 automated water filtration and recycling, continuous CCTV monitoring, and SDRF lifebuoy/lifeguard presence.
